bifrost: bifrost_app::peek (springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs), springboard/proto/src/peek.rs, springboard/apps/files/src/peek.rs, springboard/src/files/preview.rs, springboard/sdk/src/peek_pdf.rs (PdfPreview, PdfStyle)
summary: The SDK has a Quick Look panel model (items, clamped index, Space toggle, arrow stepping), a multi-page PDF layout with page thumbnails beside the content, and a thumbnail path and cache, but the shell does not draw the floating panel and no app uses the SDK panel yet. The Files app has its own in-app preview for images, text, PDFs, audio, video and file info. Preview and thumbnail extensions, which are how Apple lets third-party file types supply previews, have no counterpart.

gaps: The shell does not draw the floating preview panel: ToShell::Preview and ToShell::PreviewClose are decoded in springboard/proto/src/peek.rs and no handler was found under springboard/src.
No app uses the SDK PreviewPanel or ThumbnailCache. Files keeps its own preview (springboard/apps/files/src/peek.rs).
No third-party preview extension API (QLPreviewProvider, QLPreviewingController, QLFilePreviewRequest, QLPreviewReply).
No QLThumbnailGenerator equivalent: no generator for a file type, no icon-mode badge, no async update, and no drawing of the thumbnail in the panel.
No QLPreviewView, previewItemDisplayState, transition source frames or full-screen mode.
